params.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER: a young man with short blonde hair, light stubble, blue eyes, a navy T-shirt, grey jeans and grey sneakers. Image 2 is the SCENE, in which the same man sits at the desk with his back to us.

Change ONE thing in Image 2: the man and his office chair are now turned right round to face us. Keep Image 2 unchanged in every other respect — same camera, same framing, same desk, monitors, cork board, whiteboard, printer bench, shelf, lamp, mug, bell and striped cannon, same paper and palette.

POSITION: he sits in the same office chair on the same spot in front of the desk, but the chair has swivelled a half turn so its back is now towards the desk and the monitors, and he sits facing us. Do not draw a second chair and do not move the desk.
SCALE: the same full-grown adult at the same size as before — seated, his head rises above the chair back and sits in front of the middle monitor, his shoulders as wide as the chair back.
FACING — this is the important part: he is turned three-quarters TOWARDS US, his back to the desk and the monitors. His whole face is visible — both eyes, the stubble, his mouth, his full head of hair — and his chest, both arms and both knees. He is NOT seen from behind and NOT in profile. His eyes are open and level, looking out into the room a little to one side of the camera, never into the lens. His expression is a calm, warm, closed-mouth smile.
POSE: he sits upright and still, at rest, both forearms resting along the armrests of the chair, both hands relaxed, both feet flat on the floor. Draw a soft graphite contact shadow on the floor beneath his feet and the chair.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no 3D. Do not add any text.
